## About
We're from here. Matthew Lorand Roofing is a family-owned roofing and restoration company with long-held roots in the Austin community. Our team brings decades of experience with asphalt, metal and tile roofs, and we know what hail and wind can do to a Central Texas home.
We fix and replace roofs, handle storm damage, and can take care of drywall and other interior repairs once the roof is sound. We're a preferred contractor with Owens Corning and GAF, and we'll walk you through the insurance claim if you have one.
We've grown because people tell their neighbors about us. Our customers have given us a 5 rating across 510 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn yours the same way: clear communication, honest pricing and work done right.

## Services
- Roof repair: Repairs for leaks, missing shingles, flashing problems and hail or wind damage, so water stays out of your house.
- Roof replacement: New roofs in asphalt shingles, standing-seam metal, tile and more, with clear timelines and as little disruption to your home as we can manage.
- Roof inspection: A detailed look at your shingles, flashing and overall structure, so you know where your roof stands.
- Storm and hail damage restoration: Full restoration of roofs damaged by hail, wind and debris, with guidance through the whole process.
- Solar attic fans: Professional installation of solar attic fans to help bring down attic temperatures and take some load off your AC.
- Interior repairs and renovations: Once the roof is fixed, we can repair drywall and handle other interior repairs and renovations.

## FAQ
Q: How long does a roof replacement take?
A: Most residential roof replacements in Austin take 1 to 3 days, depending on the size, slope and material of your roof. Specialty materials or complex designs can add a little time.

Q: Is storm damage usually covered by my policy?
A: It depends on your policy and what caused the damage. Hail or wind damage is often covered, while normal wear and tear usually isn't. We can help with claim documentation and coordinating with your adjuster.

Q: What should I do after a hailstorm?
A: Stay safe, take photos of any damage you can see, and call us for a professional assessment.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. We offer 100% financing options for roof replacements, roof repairs and renovations.

Q: Can I call outside normal business hours?
A: Yes. Call us any time and we'll answer.
